verification_tolerances.note: Production's tiny-z first-order branch and independent cubic limiting transcription differ slightly; tolerance is applied to the IV map and Q, not used to certify weak directions.

limitations: Synthetic quotes and holdout IVs come from the same Hagan approximate map. General exact SABR prices/dynamics and approximation error remain unvalidated.
SLSQP and bounded TRF success are local numerical results; finite starts/grids and twelve extra points per curve do not prove global profile minima or unseen support components.
Six noisy best-solution slots have numerically unresolved Jacobian directions; sparse 2x3 matrices retain a third zero singular value and full right nullspace.
Chi-square is a descriptive pointwise reference. Sixteen noisy repetitions and known-only Wilson intervals do not certify 95% coverage, especially at bounds/nonidentification.
Holdout price widths cover finite converged visits only. Noiseless price visits additionally meet the 1e-9 IV tolerance; delta-Q-only curve components are separate geometry.

Timing captures this CPU/WSL invocation, including large checkpoint I/O. Nested fit/solver/diagnostic categories are not additive, and validation/fresh/review costs are not pooled into original numerical counters.
